name: loop_planner
description: Default PLANNER extension point for loop_engine. Produces (or revises, on replan) a concrete strategy the actor follows. Swap by passing planner_workflow to loop_engine.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var e=(''+($.effort||'default')).toLowerCase().trim(); var mt=1200; if(e==='medium'){mt=1800;} else if(e==='high'){mt=2400;} return { max_tokens: mt }; })();

messages.message: You are the PLANNING module inside an engineered agent loop. Produce a concise, concrete strategy the execution agent can follow to satisfy the objective and EVERY acceptance criterion. If prior failed attempts are listed, diagnose why they failed and change the approach — never repeat a strategy that already failed. Output a short numbered plan only. No preamble.
